summary: Tested the admin free 1-day trial (once per CPF), backend and UI. Found and fixed a CRITICAL regression: adding trial_used/trial_at to User removed the @property decorator on User.expired (server.py ~line 243). That made user.expired a bound method, which is always truthy. Effects: every approved driver got status 'expired' from POST /api/auth/cpf, every driver token was rejected by CurrentUser (line ~334), and admin_view returned expired={}, so the UI showed approved users as Vencido. After restoring @property: 9/9 new trial tests pass, the full suite passes 169/169 (pytest -n0), and the /admin UI flow works end-to-end at 375x667.

critical.endpoint: User.expired (POST /api/auth/cpf, all driver-auth endpoints, admin list)
critical.issue: The @property decorator was dropped when the trial fields were added, so expired was always truthy. FIXED by the testing agent (decorator restored).

minor.issue: The trial_used check and the $set are not atomic: two concurrent requests can both pass the check. Suggest update_one with filter {trial_used: {$ne: true}} and return 409 when matched_count == 0.

Trial is also accepted for approved users with a longer or unlimited period (their expiry is cut to now+24h) and for blocked users (they get unblocked). This may be intended, but it is a risk for the admin.

issues: The 'Liberar teste de 1 dia' button still shows on approved, active users who never used the trial (for example after a 7-day or Sem prazo grant). One tap shortens their access to 1 day and burns the trial. Consider showing it only for pending (or expired) users, or asking for confirmation.

action_items: Keep the restored @property on User.expired (server.py). Add a regression test if needed: test_admin_trial.py::test_trial_on_pending asserts expired is False.
Optional: make the trial grant atomic (filter on trial_used != true in update_one).
Optional: hide the trial button, or ask for confirmation, for users who are already approved and active.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~243: the missing blank line and @property was the root cause of the regression. Pydantic models with methods used as properties need the decorator.
admin.tsx: the trial button is 44px tall (meets touch target), uses busy/disabled, and errors surface in admin-error. OK.

success_rate.backend: 100% (169/169 after fix; 2/9 trial tests failed before the fix)

seed_data_creation: 2 pending TEST_ui25 users were inserted for the UI test and deleted by id. The pytest users (TEST_trial) were deleted by id in fixture teardown. No seed or user data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ADMIN_PASSWORD is not in backend/.env but is in the agent shell env (os.environ). The existing tests' _env() reads os.environ first, so admin login works. test_admin_trial.py mints an admin JWT with JWT_SECRET. Run with pytest -n0.
rca_of_issue: Diff HEAD~1 shows '-    @property' replaced by the two new field lines in class User. Reproduce: an approved user with expires_at=None logs in via /api/auth/cpf and gets {status:'expired'}. Mitigation: re-add @property (done).
